Forcing them to interact could lead to more tension and make the situation worse. 2. **Understand the conflict**: Try to understand the reasons behind their falling out. You could reach out to other friends or community members to help with the event. 5. **Be a good listener**: If your friends do decide to talk things through, be a good listener and offer support. Sometimes, people just need someone to listen to their concerns and validate their feelings. Remember, Kwame, you can't force people to get along or resolve their issues.
